q: For the quadratic family fc(z)=z²+c, if c is in the interior of the main cardioid of the Mandelbrot set, then fc has:
opts: A repelling fixed point and a Julia set that is a Cantor set
An attracting fixed point and a connected Julia set
exp: Parameters in the main cardioid correspond to fc having an attracting fixed point (multiplier |λ|<1). The Julia set is connected (since c∈M). The filled Julia set is a simply connected region around the attracting fixed point.
